inputs.note: Needs the locate step (feat/w2-locate). The exclusion is a property of the VALUE CLASS, not of one field: app/extraction/locate.py EXACT_ONLY_VALUE_CLASSES = {NUMERIC, UNIT, DATE, FLAG}. Drive locate() with a candidate one character off in each of the four classes — `111` for a drawn `11.1`, `mg/dt` for `mg/dL`, `2026-03-02` for `2026-08-02`, `H` for `N` — on a scanned page, under every FuzzyMode including ALWAYS. W2-C7 asserts the numeric case against one fixture; this asserts the rule over the whole class set and over the tier order, which is where it would be re-introduced.

expected: On a scanned page, a one-character-off value in any of the four exact-only classes is NOT located by any tier — not exact, not numeric, not number_only, and not fuzzy even with FuzzyMode.ALWAYS. It comes back not_located and is disclosed as unsupported.
guards_against: A fuzzy tier re-admitted for a value class where a near miss changes the meaning. The damage is the same in all four: a misread number, a misread unit (mg/dL read as mg/dt, or worse, matched to a different unit's column), a misread collection date, and a misread flag all acquire a bbox and become located facts with a citation a reviewer can click and confirm. It is worse than finding nothing, because it converts the one signal that says `code could not place this` into evidence that it is on the page.
